hooks.name: Warn on innerHTML in dashboard
hooks.description: Keeps untrusted log text out of HTML.

action.prompt: Before writing, check the content. Log text is untrusted: do not use innerHTML, outerHTML or insertAdjacentHTML with event data in src/chimericmesh/web. Use textContent. Also never write CR/LF/NUL to IRC sockets without format_privmsg.
